name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Sofia Moon and Robert Moon, married twelve years by the time you arrived. She was an office clerk, he was a hairdresser. There was always food on the table and never quite enough for the rest. You were the second child. Viktor came first and never let you forget it. Your grandmother Linda raised four children alone and had no patience for giving up. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Sofia Moon and Robert Moon — a getting by household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.
